Clarify command and prefix case rules
commitResults.messageBody:
The User Guide incorrectly implies that client command prefixes may
be case-sensitive, despite accepting either case.

Clarify the rules for client and property commands and explain that
free-text values retain their capitalisation.

Fixes #239

commitResults.messageTitle: Align glossary with supported property flows
commitResults.messageBody:
The glossary still refers to rental transactions and a client-level
buying status, although RESIDEX supports buying and selling properties
with property-level transaction stages.

Remove the obsolete buying-status entry and rental references to keep
the glossary consistent with the supported workflows.

Fixes #242

Invalid client indexes such as 0 and 01 currently produce generic
command usage instead of explaining the positive-integer rule.

Show the existing client-index guidance for delete, view, edit and
remark while retaining usage for missing indexes. Keep validation
rules unchanged and update the relevant parser and regression tests.

Fixes #240

commitResults.messageTitle: Align remark usage example with the guides
commitResults.messageBody:
Use Call next week in the remark usage message to match the User Guide
and in-app help.

Fixes #241

Document @rayyngg's use of Codex for code review, bug fixes, tests and
project documentation, including commit and pull request drafts.

Record the tool and extent of assistance in the Developer Guide
acknowledgements to meet the course reuse policy.
Docs: Correct v1.6 command, migration and setup guidance

commitResults.messageTitle: Distinguish extra input from invalid indexes
commitResults.messageBody:
Commands such as view 1 2 currently report an invalid positive integer
even though the problem is extra input.

Show command usage for missing or multiple index tokens in delete,
view, edit and remark. Retain the specific index error for invalid
single tokens such as 0 and 01, and cover both cases in regression
tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep redo history when a command fails to save
commitResults.messageBody:
A failed save rolled back by undoing the committed change and then
discarding all redo states, so redo history that existed before the
failed command was lost. Cancel the latest commit instead, restoring the
history exactly as it was.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject extra input after commands that take no parameters
commitResults.messageBody:
help, list, undo, redo and exit silently ignored anything typed after
the command word, so `undo 3` undid one step without saying so. Show an
error instead, and update the User Guide to match.

declaration of notable AI use.
